## Purpose and Entry Points
Skills Manager is a cross-platform desktop application and companion CLI for maintaining a central library of AI-agent skills, deploying them to global/project tool directories, and backing them up through Git. The React/Tauri desktop entry path is `src/main.tsx` → `src/App.tsx` → Rust host `src-tauri/src/main.rs` / `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`. The shared-core CLI entry point is `src-tauri/src/bin/skills-manager-cli.rs`.

## Desktop UI and Client Boundary
The frontend is React 19/TypeScript built by Vite, with Tauri IPC as its backend boundary. Application-wide state and command integration are centered in `src/context/AppContext.tsx` and `src/lib/tauri.ts`. Primary UI domains are library installation and management (`src/views/MySkills.tsx`, `src/views/InstallSkills.tsx`), global/project/linked workspaces (`src/views/WorkspaceView.tsx`, `src/views/ProjectDetail.tsx`), and backup/settings (`src/views/Backup.tsx`, `src/views/Settings.tsx`).

## Rust Command API and Application State
Tauri commands provide the explicit UI-to-core API and partition operations by business domain: skills, workspaces/projects, sync, backup Git, settings, scanning, and tool management. Main command registration/module boundary is `src-tauri/src/commands/mod.rs`; representative handlers include `src-tauri/src/commands/skills.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/sync.rs`, and `src-tauri/src/commands/git_backup.rs`. Shared initialization, database handles, configuration, and runtime services are coordinated through `src-tauri/src/core/app_state.rs`.

## Central Library, Metadata, and Installation
The canonical skill content lives in a configurable central repository (default `~/.skills-manager`), while SQLite holds rebuildable metadata such as tags, presets, source state, and per-agent toggles. Storage and import/update behavior are implemented by `src-tauri/src/core/skill_store.rs`, `src-tauri/src/core/skill_metadata.rs`, and `src-tauri/src/core/installer.rs`. Inputs cross a trust/path boundary—local folders, archives, Git sources, and skills.sh—and are guarded by `src-tauri/src/core/path_guard.rs`; content hashes support change detection in `src-tauri/src/core/content_hash.rs`.

## Workspaces, Tool Adapters, and Sync
Tool adapters define supported agents/custom tools and their global or project-local skill directories. `src-tauri/src/core/tool_adapters.rs` and `src-tauri/src/core/tool_service.rs` resolve target paths and capabilities. Scanner services inspect both managed and externally present skills (`src-tauri/src/core/scanner.rs`, `src-tauri/src/core/project_scanner.rs`), enabling adoption and live workspace views. `src-tauri/src/core/sync_engine.rs` applies preset/library selections to targets via copy or symlink, with installation cancellation coordination in `src-tauri/src/core/install_cancel.rs`.

## Git Backup, Remote Sync, and Conflict Handling
The central library can be versioned and synchronized against arbitrary Git remotes or GitHub-created private repositories. Git execution/credentials/remotes are isolated in `src-tauri/src/core/git_backup.rs`, `src-tauri/src/core/git2_engine.rs`, and `src-tauri/src/core/github_api.rs`; GitHub device authorization tokens are handled through platform-secure credential support. Background backup behavior is managed by `src-tauri/src/core/auto_backup.rs`. Skill-aware cross-device merge is a separate subsystem—protocol, snapshots, validation, conflict decisions, and application live under `src-tauri/src/core/merge/mod.rs`, `src-tauri/src/core/merge/resolve.rs`, and `src-tauri/src/core/merge/apply.rs`.

## Runtime, Infrastructure, and Safety
The packaged runtime is Tauri 2 with Rust, SQLite (`rusqlite`), React, Tailwind, and i18n resources under `src/i18n/`. Desktop permissions/capabilities and packaging are defined in `src-tauri/capabilities/default.json` and `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`. File watching, repository locking, migrations, audit logging, and panic-safe diagnostics protect concurrent desktop/CLI use and filesystem mutation: `src-tauri/src/core/file_watcher.rs`, `src-tauri/src/core/repo_lock.rs`, and `src-tauri/src/core/audit_log.rs`.
